crossRefs.note: Jesus said to him, “Have I been with you such a long time, and do you not know me, Philip? He who has seen me has seen…
Therefore they took up stones to throw at him, but Jesus was hidden, and went out of the temple, having gone through…
But he, passing through the middle of them, went his way.
Their eyes were opened and they recognized him, then he vanished out of their sight.

people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

translations.web: But he who was healed didn’t know who it was, for Jesus had withdrawn, a crowd being in the place.
translations.bsb: But the man who was healed did not know who it was, for Jesus had slipped away while the crowd was there.
translations.kjv: And he that was healed wist not who it was: for Jesus had conveyed himself away, a multitude being in that place.
translations.asv: But he that was healed knew not who it was; for Jesus had conveyed himself away, a multitude being in the place.
